row: Feasibility study: dynamical substitution geometry via Regge / CDT (test T1 of FEASIBILITY_scoping.md)

scorer.interpreter: /workspace/qsim-venv/bin/python -I (system python lacks scipy, which chair.py imports)
scorer.complex_source: read-only import of /workspace/qis-eth/mirror/toe/src/chair.py (supertile, owner_grid, FR30, proper_rule); sys.dont_write_bytecode=True

complex: T_L = level-L chair supertile, 8^L tiles in an N^3 box, N = 2^(L+1); cells = chair tiles (each 7 unit cubes); shared faces = unit faces between cubes owned by different tiles.
metric_space: M_L = { g: tiles -> Sym(3,R), constant per chair tile } with tangential-tangential continuity: for every shared unit face with normal axis k, g_a[i,j] = g_b[i,j] for all i,j != k. Flat-in-tile Regge-type metric (cells are cubical, axis-aligned faces; no Kuhn subdivision).

quantities.N_L: dim M_L = sum over the 6 components (i,j) of #connected components of the tile graph with edges = shared faces of normal k not in {i,j}. Exact (graph components). Trivial value 6 = global constant metrics (GL(3)/O(3) orbit), i.e. dimension beyond trivial = N_L - 6.
quantities.N_int_L: same sum, counting only components that contain at least one interior tile (no cube face of the tile on the region boundary). Trivial value 6.
quantities.G_L: dimension of the image in M_L of linearised continuous tile-wise affine deformations u (delta g = A + A^T on each tile); the 'modulo discrete diffeos' gauge. Always 6 <= G_L <= N_L.
quantities.Q_L: N_L - G_L = linearised tile-local metric moduli not removable by tile-wise affine gauge.
quantities.rank_method: pivot rows mod p = 2^31-1, then certified over Q by exact Fraction nullspace of pivot rows plus exact integer check that all rows annihilate it; flags certified_K/certified_G. Any uncertified rank is reported as a lower bound only (rank_p <= rank_Q).

validation.V1: cube complex (each unit cube of the T_L region its own cell, same continuity): N_cube(L) = 3n + 3n^2 with n = 2^(L+1), exactly, L = 1..3. Proof [P]: x-slabs of the region are connected (g_xx = f(x)), z-columns are contiguous (g_xy = h(x,y)). If V1 fails, the run is invalid and no H verdict is issued.

hypotheses.H1: N_L = 6 exactly for FR30 and 1387, every L in 1..5 (no tile-local metric moduli beyond the trivial global ones). Pass iff all 10 equalities hold; fail otherwise.
hypotheses.H1b: N_int_L = 6 exactly for both rules, L in 2..5. Pass iff all 8 hold.
hypotheses.H2: FR30 and 1387 give identical tile partitions (sha256 of sorted cube sets) and identical N, N_int, G, Q at every L in 1..5. Pass iff all equal.
hypotheses.H3: Q_L = 0 exactly for both rules, every L in 1..5. Pass iff all hold.

reported_without_prediction: per-component counts and largest component sizes
compute_cap: box only, <= 2 threads (OMP/OPENBLAS=2, single python process), <= 30 min wall (timeout 1800; levels not reached are reported 'not run').
disclosed_prior_runs: Before freezing, one smoke run (--smoke) on L = 0 only (not a preregistered level): tile L0 N=6 G=6 Q=0; cube L0 N=18 (=3*2+3*4) G=15 Q=3. No preregistered level was computed.
labels: [C] computed counts, [P] only for proved statements, [F] failed predictions; no refit; any correction goes into a new prereg v2 with its own hash.
implication_rule: If H1 and H3 pass: tile-wise constant tt-continuous Regge metrics on the chair complex are rigid (no tile-local moduli), so route R1 cannot attach local metric DOF to chair tiles at this resolution and must refine (e.g. Kuhn/edge-length Regge) or drop. If H1 fails with N_L growing with 8^L: R1 has a nontrivial local metric configuration space to build on.
